Times tables practice

The 11 times table.

Practise the 11 times table up to 11 × 12. Use equal groups to explain multiplication, then connect each fact to division.

Practise the 11 times table

11 times table facts up to 12.

11 × 1 = 11

11 × 2 = 22

11 × 3 = 33

11 × 4 = 44

11 × 5 = 55

11 × 6 = 66

11 × 7 = 77

11 × 8 = 88

11 × 9 = 99

11 × 10 = 110

11 × 11 = 121

11 × 12 = 132

Connect multiplication and division.

11 × 4 = 44

Four equal groups of 11 make 44.

44 ÷ 11 = 4

11 × ? = 44

Try the related division fact and a missing factor after a multiplication answer. KickMaths records the different forms so that later recall is checked rather than assumed.
